subject: [REMINDER]: Airflow Dev call on 29th January - agenda

messages.subject: [REMINDER]: Airflow Dev call on 29th January - agenda
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

Here is a quick reminder that we have our Airflow dev call, on Thursday,
29th January 2026 at 8AM PST (11 am EST | 4 pm UTC / GMT). The agenda is
fairly full, but if you have additional quick topics to squeeze in, feel
free to add on the wiki page or slack me.

Proposed agenda:
1. Catch-up on action items from last call
- TBD

2. Development Updates and Presentations:
- Swim lane updates:
-- UI / API update - Brent / Pierre
-- UI test framework update - Rahul Vats

- Airflow 3.2 update
-- Multi-team update (Niko)
-- Deadline alerts update? (Dennis / Ramit)
-- Asset Partitions update? (Daniel Standish / Wei Lee)

3. Discussion topics:
- AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI - Pavan
- AIP-95 Provider lifecycle governance - Vikram
- AIP-94 Decouple remote commands from Airflow CLI - Bugra
- AIP-100 Eliminate Scheduler starvation on concurrency limits - Natanel

The zoom link for the invite is

For additions to the agenda, please feel free to add a comment to the wiki
page
<https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=373886699#Airflow3.xDevCall:Meetingnotes-ProposedAgenda.31>
or
send me an email. The summary of the call will also be sent to the mailing
list and posted on the same wiki page.

Looking forward to seeing you all soon,
Vikram

--

Vikram Koka
Chief Strategy Officer
Email: vikram@astronomer.io


<https://www.astronomer.io/>
